title: NHK Web やさしい日本語 — お買い物の日本語 (Shopping in Japanese)
description: From NHK Web やさしい日本語. Covers practical shopping vocabulary and phrases: asking for sizes and colours, checking prices, using fitting rooms, paying by cash and IC card, and polite shop-floor expressions (いらっしゃいませ、〜はございますか、お会計はこちらへ). Set in a clothing shop and a supermarket.
creator: NHK (日本放送協会)
